summary_en: 92,100 shares acquired via open-market purchase in July 2026 for ¥186.5M. Cumulative to 31 July: 140,700 shares (0.55% S/O) for ¥268.6M, against authorized limit of 300,000 shares (1.18% S/O) and ¥500M through 30 September 2026.
title_en: Notice of Market Purchase of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: SoftCreate Holdings filed a progress notice on 31 July 2026 reporting open-market purchases of treasury stock during July 2026. In the month of July alone, the company acquired 92,100 shares for ¥186,548,100 via the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Cumulative acquisitions through 31 July reached 140,700 shares for ¥268,622,200. The buyback was authorized by the board on 15 June 2026 under Articles 156 and 165 of the Companies Act, with an upper limit of 300,000 shares (1.18% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) valued at up to ¥500,000,000, to be executed between 16 June and 30 September 2026. As of the filing date, approximately 47% of the authorized share count and 54% of the authorized budget had been consumed.
